# Xoom project assistant onboarding

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root before beginning work. This establishes the mandatory documentation, evidence, integrity, permission and handoff requirements.

Find the verified project state through [project-archive/DIRECTORY.md](../project-archive/DIRECTORY.md), then follow linked DIRECTORY.md documents through the affected recovery or Toolkit revision. Maintain those records **at every affected ancestor to the project root** as development proceeds, and do not promote older plans into current claims without verification.

The [process handbook](../project-archive/processes/DIRECTORY.md) documents commonly standardized practices; these are **references**, not inflexible scripts. Alternatives are welcome when appropriate if significant departures and results are documented. Hardware flash approval and other safety/security boundaries remain mandatory.
